frozen_candidate_root_contribution: jEl (Form I only; finite verb, active participle jaAEil, and passive juEila behave identically) is a single causative-resultative nucleus: an agent, by determination/decree, confers on a presupposed entity X a SECOND determination Y - a resultant state, status/role, position/placement, relation, allotment, or predication. The verb asserts the instituting act and its resultant arrangement; the specific value (transform / appoint / place / bestow / ascribe / reckon-as) is compositional on the complement Y, not lexicalized in the verb. Crucially the verb is efficacy- and truth-neutral (a human agent can jEl a false status) and does NOT itself entail origination of the substance involved - that work is reserved for khalq.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 346 occurrences jEl means to put/constitute an already-available thing into a stipulated condition, standing, place, or relation. It almost never appears without a second complement (predicate accusative, ka-comparison, fi/ala/bayna locative, or li-dative), so its own contribution is constant - 'confer determination Y on X' - while the surface sense (make-into, appoint, place, provide, ascribe, deem-as) is fixed by that complement. The Qur'an systematically withholds jEl from substance-creation and reserves khalq for it, often in the same verse (khalaqa ... wa-jaEala; khalaqa ... fa-jaEalahu), which is the load-bearing positive evidence that jEl means arrangement/institution, not origination. The verb is also value- and truth-neutral: the identical form is used for God's legitimate institution and for the mushrikun's false attributions, so legitimacy tracks the agent, not the root.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: NOT origination-of-substance (that is khalq: 6:1:7:2 khalaqa... wa-jaEala l-zulumati wa-l-nur; 25:54:7:2 khalaqa mina l-ma'i basharan fa-jaEalahu nasaban; 76:2:8:2 khalaqna l-insana... fa-jaEalnahu samiEan; the polemic 13:16:30:1 jaEaluu... shuraka'a khalaquu ka-khalqihi separates assigning from creating). NOT truth-/efficacy-entailing (Y may be false: 6:100:1:2, 43:19:1:2, 16:57:1:2; meta-comment 33:4:2:1 dhalikum qawlukum bi-afwahikum). NOT permanence-entailing (contingent: 25:45:13:1 law sha'a la-jaEalahu sakinan; 56:65:3:2 law nasha'u la-jaEalnahu hutaman). NOT the generic 'do/act' fEl/Eml (jEl always yields a state/relation, cf. 27:34:8:2 wa-kadhalika yafEaluun beside jaEaluu). NOT reflexive self-appropriation ittakhadha (jEl can target a third party/others' benefit: 2:22:19:1 la tajEaluu lillahi andadan). The inchoative auxiliary 'began to (jaEala yafEalu)' is ABSENT from the packet.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 21:30:11:2 wa-jaEalna mina l-ma'i kulla shay'in hayy ('and We made from water every living thing') - here jEl performs origination-work otherwise reserved for khalq, straining the single crisp negative boundary (not create-substance) that gives the thin nucleus its content; it is only partly mitigated by the min al-ma'i source-phrase framing the act as constituting-from-material (parallel to 25:54:7:2 khalaqa mina l-ma'i basharan fa-jaEalahu) rather than ex nihilo. Reinforced by 39:6:6:1 jaEala minha zawjaha.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two (or more) unbridged senses rather than one nucleus: (i) efficacious institution/placement/appointment/transformation, versus (ii) a declarative predication/allegation micro-class ('deem/allege/reckon-as', esp. the shirk-ascription idiom 6:100, 43:19, 16:57, and elliptical 56:82). Under this competitor the bridge 'efficacy = f(agent power)' is a theological inference, not a demonstrated lexical unity. It is downgraded (not certified) because the reckon-as frame (a-najEalu ... ka-...) occurs with a DIVINE subject too (38:28:2:1, 68:35:1:3) mirroring the human 29:10:11:1, so the evaluative/declarative use is not a separate human-only lexeme - it plugs into the same 'confer determination Y on X' frame; and 13:16:30:1 itself thematizes the human's bare positing against real khalq. A second competitor - that jEl is a wholly empty light verb with no root contribution - is rejected because a pure light verb would not be systematically barred from khalq's substance-creation role, yet it is (6:1, 25:54, 39:6, 76:2, 35:11:9:1).

internal_discovery.rationale: All three independent lenses (A, B, and adversary C) converged on a single Form-I nucleus and none reached RESISTANT/UNRESOLVED for the root. Morphology is flat (one Form-I paradigm; qac_verb_form null for all 346; participle and passive span the same range with no seam), so the decisive analytic dimension is the argument frame, and the frames grade continuously and co-occur under one verb in single verses (27:61, 16:80-81, 71:12), which bridges them Qur'an-internally. The nucleus earns real (if schematic) content from a conserved khalq/jEl division of labor - falsifiable and repeatedly attested - and from the exceptionless resultative second-complement syntax (no bare 'jaEala X = brought X into existence'). Honest downgrades: (a) the nucleus is thin/high-altitude and its discriminative work is largely efficacy-neutrality plus the khalq boundary; (b) the declarative/allegation micro-class is bridged by inference, not demonstration; (c) 21:30/39:6 strain the sole crisp boundary. These are recorded as hard cases and counterevidence rather than allowed to fracture a demonstrably frame-driven unity. Strength is STRONG on breadth (346, well-distributed, both agent-types, all forms) and distinctiveness (khalq, ittakhadha, fEl contrasts), but falsification is left NOT_RUN because residual origination strain (21:30, 39:6) means a clean SUPPORTED-with-no-failing-occurrences certification is not warranted.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Finite Form-I verb (perfect jaEala/jaEalo, imperfect yajEalu, imperative ojEal, and the single passive juEila 16:124:2:1): an agent confers a second determination Y on a presupposed X - render/constitute X as Y (2:143:2:1, 105:5:1:2), appoint/constitute as a status (19:30:7:2, 21:73:1:2), place X in/on/between a locus (12:70:4:1, 13:3:5:2), assign/provide Y for a beneficiary (16:78:9:2, 65:2:28:1), ascribe/reckon X as Y (6:100:1:2, 38:28:2:1). Value/truth/efficacy come from agent and complement, not the verb.
clusters.classification_rationale: Same nucleus across all finite forms and voices; sense-variation is compositional on the complement, not lexical. Imperative is overwhelmingly du'a' (a human petitioning God to institute a status/provision, 14:40, 2:126) and prohibitive la tajEal splits between 'do not set up a rival' and 'do not place us among', both inside the nucleus. Passive juEila (institution of the Sabbath) sits in the same institution frame.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: khalq/jEl division of labor within single verses (6:1:7:2, 25:54:7:2, 76:2:8:2, 30:21:11:2) gives positive internal evidence that finite jEl = arrangement/institution not origination; efficacy-neutrality confirmed by 33:4:2:1 (dhalikum qawlukum bi-afwahikum) and the shirk cluster.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Active participle jaAEil (2:30:6:1, 2:124:9:1, 3:55:13:2, 18:8:2:2, 28:7:20:2, 35:1:6:1): 'one who institutes/constitutes X as Y'. Agent is God in every appointment instance (making a khalifa, an imam, messengers, elevating followers) and constitutes the earth's surface into barren ground (18:8), i.e. the same confer-a-determination nucleus in nominal (participial) realization.
clusters.classification_rationale: The 6 N tokens are morphologically the Form-I active participle of the same lexeme, not a distinct derived stem; they span the appointment (A2) and transform (A1) values already found in the finite verb, so no separate nucleus is warranted.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 2:30:6:1 jaEilun fi l-ardi khalifatan and 35:1:6:1 jaEili l-mala'ikati rusulan pattern exactly with finite appointment (38:26 jaEalnaka khalifatan; 21:73 jaEalnahum a'immatan); 18:8:2:2 la-jaEiluna ma Ealayha saEidan juruzan patterns with finite transform (105:5).

reconciliation.rationale: All three lenses flag it as the single most materially resistant occurrence to the not-origination boundary; honesty requires recording it as a resistant seam and counterevidence rather than silently absorbing it, even though the min-source phrasing mitigates.
Same origination strain as 21:30; retained under the nucleus by the constitute-from-available-source reading but marked resistant to keep the load-bearing khalq boundary falsifiable and honest.
In-clause contrast with khalaqahum shows the verb is efficacy-neutral, not a different lexeme; the same li-dative assignment frame is used for genuine institution, so it reinforces the nucleus.

adversarial_verification.notes: Adversarial pressure (Lens C) refined but could not shatter the nucleus: the efficacy-neutral, khalq-contrasted schema absorbed the shirk/declarative micro-class, and the exceptionless resultative second-complement syntax blocked a pure-creation reading. However the two origination-leaning occurrences (21:30, 39:6) still strain the load-bearing not-origination boundary, so a clean SUPPORTED verdict with no failing occurrences is not warranted; certification is withheld and the residue is carried as counterevidence and RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases.

Imperative is overwhelmingly du'a' (a human petitioning God to institute a status/provision, 14:40, 2:126) and prohibitive la tajEal splits between 'do not set up a rival' and 'do not place us among', both inside the nucleus. Passive juEila (institution of the Sabbath) sits in the same institution frame.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Finite Form-I verb (perfect jaEala/jaEalo, imperfect yajEalu, imperative ojEal, and the single passive juEila 16:124:2:1): an agent confers a second determination Y on a presupposed X - render/constitute X as Y (2:143:2:1, 105:5:1:2), appoint/constitute as a status (19:30:7:2, 21:73:1:2), place X in/on/between a locus (12:70:4:1, 13:3:5:2), assign/provide Y for a beneficiary (16:78:9:2, 65:2:28:1), ascribe/reckon X as Y (6:100:1:2, 38:28:2:1). Value/truth/efficacy come from agent and complement, not the verb.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: khalq/jEl division of labor within single verses (6:1:7:2, 25:54:7:2, 76:2:8:2, 30:21:11:2) gives positive internal evidence that finite jEl = arrangement/institution not origination; efficacy-neutrality confirmed by 33:4:2:1 (dhalikum qawlukum bi-afwahikum) and the shirk cluster.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Could read as institution-from-material (min al-ma'i as presupposed substrate).
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: All three lenses flag it as the single most materially resistant occurrence to the not-origination boundary; honesty requires recording it as a resistant seam and counterevidence rather than silently absorbing it, even though the min-source phrasing mitigates.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: min-source phrase frames it as constituting-from-material.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: Same origination strain as 21:30; retained under the nucleus by the constitute-from-available-source reading but marked resistant to keep the load-bearing khalq boundary falsifiable and honest.

independent_verification: Three independent read-only lenses (A build, B build, C adversarial) each read all 346 occurrences and converged on a single Form-I nucleus with the same khalq boundary and the same 21:30/39:6 strain, and each independently declined RESISTANT/UNRESOLVED for the root.
candidate_root_contribution: jEl (Form I only; finite verb, active participle jaAEil, and passive juEila behave identically) is a single causative-resultative nucleus: an agent, by determination/decree, confers on a presupposed entity X a SECOND determination Y - a resultant state, status/role, position/placement, relation, allotment, or predication. The verb asserts the instituting act and its resultant arrangement; the specific value (transform / appoint / place / bestow / ascribe / reckon-as) is compositional on the complement Y, not lexicalized in the verb. Crucially the verb is efficacy- and truth-neutral (a human agent can jEl a false status) and does NOT itself entail origination of the substance involved - that work is reserved for khalq.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 346 occurrences read across all surface forms; 340 finite Form-I V (incl. one passive juEila 16:124:2:1) + 6 active-participle jaAEil N; the confer-a-determination nucleus and the khalq contrast are read directly off verse_text and argument frames.
layer_attribution.derivation: Morphology is a single Form-I paradigm; qac_verb_form is null for all 346 and there is no derived stem (II-X); participle and passive show no derivational seam, so no derived-family sub-claim is available or needed.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One lexeme with frame-conditioned sense-values (transform / appoint / place / bestow / ascribe / reckon-as); the values are compositional on the complement Y, not separate lexicalized classes.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Legitimacy, efficacy, and truth of the posited Y are supplied by the agent and context (God vs. mushrikun) and by co-text (in-clause khalq contrasts), NOT by the root; this contextual polarity is deliberately excluded from the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary RESISTANT reads of the shirk/declarative cases were reconciled to CONSISTENT via efficacy-neutrality and the shared li-dative frame; 21:30 and 39:6 were reconciled the other way - kept as RESISTANT seams - to preserve the falsifiability of the khalq boundary.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: Residual, honestly retained: whether 21:30/39:6 are true origination (breaking the sole crisp boundary) and whether the declarative micro-class is a genuinely separate sense are not decidable from the packet alone; recorded as counterevidence, hard cases, and reopen conditions rather than forced.

hard_cases.reason: jEl does origination-work reserved elsewhere for khalq, straining the sole crisp negative boundary.

evidence_basis.statement: 21:30:11:2 wa-jaEalna mina l-ma'i kulla shay'in hayy performs origination-work otherwise reserved for khalq, straining the sole crisp negative boundary (not create-substance); mitigated but not neutralized by the min al-ma'i source-phrase.

hard_cases.reason: Second origination-leaning case eroding the khalq/jEl boundary.

evidence_basis.statement: 39:6:6:1 jaEala minha zawjaha pushes jEl toward origination alongside 21:30, eroding the khalq/jEl boundary; retained inside the nucleus only by reading it as constituting-from-an-available-source (parallel 25:54:7:2 khalaqa... fa-jaEalahu).

hard_cases.reason: Efficacy/truth-neutrality test: jEl produces nothing real, contrasted with khalq in-clause.

evidence_basis.statement: 6:100:1:2 wa-jaEaluu lillahi shuraka'a l-jinna wa-khalaqahum: the humans' jEl produces nothing real and is contrasted in-clause with God's khalaqahum, forcing efficacy-neutrality; this refines rather than breaks the nucleus and the polemic depends on it being the same verb.

hard_cases.reason: False-label use set against khalq; kills any productive reading.

evidence_basis.statement: 43:19:1:2 wa-jaEaluu l-mala'ikata... inathan ashahiduu khalqahum: jEl here is a false label set against khalq, killing any productive/creative reading and confirming truth-neutrality.

hard_cases.reason: Declarative false-ascription in the same li-dative frame as genuine institution.

evidence_basis.statement: 16:57:1:2 wa-yajEaluuna lillahi l-banati: declarative false-ascription in the identical li-dative frame used for genuine institution (16:78 jaEala lakum l-samE), so it plugs into the assignment value of the nucleus applied falsely.

hard_cases.reason: Elliptical/obscure clause fitting the nucleus only under a stretched paraphrase.

evidence_basis.statement: 56:82:1:2 wa-tajEaluuna rizqakum annakum tukadhdhibuun is genuinely elliptical/obscure; reads as declarative-attitudinal ('you make [your response to] your provision to be that you deny') and fits the confer-a-determination nucleus only under a stretched paraphrase.

hard_cases.reason: Concrete physical emplacement refuting the rich 'confer status/office' gloss.

evidence_basis.statement: 12:70:4:1 jaEala l-siqayata fi rahli akhihi is plain physical emplacement of a concrete movable object with no status/role/transform; it refutes any rich 'confer a status/office' gloss as the core and forces the thin 'institute a position/state' formulation, which survives it.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The core nucleus holds across 346 occurrences, but genuine hard cases persist and are each derived from specific packet evidence: two origination-leaning RESISTANT seams (21:30, 39:6), three adversarial boundaries testing efficacy/truth-neutrality and the declarative micro-class (6:100, 43:19, 16:57), one gloss-refuting concrete emplacement (12:70), and one structurally atypical elliptical clause (56:82). Each statement is persisted verbatim in the corresponding occurrence_override note.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A finite jEl occurrence that means substance-origination ex nihilo with no second determination (a bare 'jaEala X' = 'created X') and is NOT contrastable with khalq, OR a coherent set of occurrences in which jEl's sense is fixed independently of its complement - either would show the proposed universal single confer-a-determination nucleus is not root-wide but a forced abstraction.
rejection_condition.search_location: The finite V cluster, especially single-object jEl (6:1:7:2 zulumat/nur) and the origination-leaning cases 21:30:11:2, 39:6:6:1, plus every jEl+min-source construction and the shirk/declarative cluster 6:100:1:2, 43:19:1:2, 16:57:1:2, 56:82:1:2.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each candidate with its verse_text and morphology; test whether a second determination Y (predicate accusative, ka-, fi/ala/bayna, or li-dative) is present and whether khalq is available/contrasted; check whether removing the complement leaves a stable 'create' meaning.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not let contextual/theological inference ('God's jEl is efficacious') substitute for lexical evidence; treat divine-agent efficacy as agent-supplied, not verb-supplied; exclude the absent inchoative sense from external Arabic; keep khalq occurrences out of the jEl evidence base.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If the challenging finding is confirmed, demote from UNIVERSAL/ROOT_GENERALIZATION to a REPRESENTATIVE lexicalized-class account (efficacious-institution vs. declarative-ascription) or to UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY if the origination cases cannot be bridged to the confer-a-determination nucleus.

reopen_conditions: If a re-analysis of the origination-leaning cases 21:30:11:2 (wa-jaEalna mina l-ma'i kulla shay'in hayy) and 39:6:6:1 (jaEala minha zawjaha) shows jEl there means ex-nihilo creation rather than constituting-from-an-available-source, reopen the not-origination boundary and the universal scope.

If the declarative/allegation cluster (6:100:1:2, 43:19:1:2, 16:57:1:2, 56:82:1:2) is shown to be fixed as 'allege/claim' independently of the li-dative assignment frame - i.e. not bridgeable to the confer-a-determination nucleus - reopen toward a two-sense (institution vs. declarative-ascription) account.
If a jEl occurrence is found where the reading is fixed with no second determination Y present, reopen the claim that sense is compositional-on-complement.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: Adversarial pressure (Lens C) refined but could not shatter the nucleus: the efficacy-neutral, khalq-contrasted schema absorbed the shirk/declarative micro-class, and the exceptionless resultative second-complement syntax blocked a pure-creation reading. However the two origination-leaning occurrences (21:30, 39:6) still strain the load-bearing not-origination boundary, so a clean SUPPORTED verdict with no failing occurrences is not warranted; certification is withheld and the residue is carried as counterevidence and RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases.
